# AK-214 -- Stop retrying client errors

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | implementation |
| Status | approved (2026-09-22, platform tech lead) |
| Work source | incident review: duplicate 400s in the payments provider's logs |
| Integration owner | platform team |
| Prerequisites | none |

## Goal

`withRetry` (`src/http/retry.js`) retries every 4xx response, so a request
the server has already rejected as invalid is sent up to three times. The
retry helper stops retrying on a 4xx response. A 429 is the exception: the
server is asking the client to come back later, so it is still retried.

## Non-goals

- Changing the number of attempts or the backoff.
- Changing any caller of `withRetry`.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1** -- a 429 response is still retried.
  Verification: `npm run check -- --test-name-pattern="AK-214 AC-1"`
- **AC-2** -- a 400 response is not retried: the wrapped call runs once and
  its error is rethrown unchanged.
  Verification: `npm run check -- --test-name-pattern="AK-214 AC-2"`

## Allowed changes

- `src/http/retry.js`
- `test/http/retry.test.js`

## Read dependencies

- `src/http/errors.js`

## Write ownership

`src/http/retry.js` and `test/http/retry.test.js`, exclusive to this ticket.

## Stop conditions

Stop and report if meeting AC-2 needs a change outside the allowed files.
